desc: Parse stdin, strip newline, and store S plus its reverse.
Implement KMP prefix function for the combined string.
Correct the algorithm: use T = rev(S) + '#' + S so pi[-1] gives M = longest palindromic suffix length; answer = S + R[M:].
Verify corrected code on samples (ABC→ABCBA, Z→Z, TREE→TREERT) and edge cases (n=1, already-palindrome S, all-same-character S).
